text:
alex_fin: Quick heads-up — I found a $39,600 variance between prepaid Dedicated deferrals and the invoices we have for AcmeCorp for March. Need to lock entries before month-close. CSV attached to thread.

maria_revops: Oof. Is that timing or wrong invoice amount? Which invoice(s) are involved?

alex_fin: Looks like invoice INV-98765 issued 2026-03-20 for $180,000 but our deferral schedule shows $219,600 recognized for the period. Automated deferral check flagged it.

jordan_accounting: Can you paste the recognition schedule lines here? I want to see start/end dates and per-period amounts. Also need the contract effective date and any amendment IDs.

alex_fin: CSV snippet pasted:
```
customer,contract_id,amendment_id,invoice,invoice_date,billed_amount,period_start,period_end,recognized_amount
AcmeCorp,C-2334,A-345,INV-98765,2026-03-20,180000,2026-03-01,2026-08-31,219600
```
(we're recognizing monthly; the recognized_amount total is from the schedule generator)

sam_salesops: We pushed an amendment A-345 on 2026-03-10 to add burst capacity but the sales order notes said billing should start 2026-04-01. Looks like billing used 2026-03-01 as the start. I filed the SFDC amendment; link: https://salesforce.company/C-2334/A-345

jordan_accounting: That would explain it — revenue recognized earlier than invoiced term. If billing billed 3/1 but effective date is 4/1 then our deferral should not include March. Need signed amendment date to determine proper recognition.

billing-bot: invoice-correction created INV-98765-R1 (parent INV-98765) — status: pending. See https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-98765-R1

maria_revops: For month-end, we need a conservative approach. I approve a provisional deferral adjustment up to $40k pending confirmation. @sam_salesops can you confirm signature date and whether sales wants a credit or reissue?

sam_salesops: Confirmed — amendment was signed by customer on 2026-03-29 (signature_date field in SFDC). Sales prefers to issue a credit and reissue a corrected invoice starting 2026-04-01, not rebill retroactively.

jordan_accounting: OK. Proposed accounting treatment: reverse the excess recognized for March ($39,600) — JE: Debit Revenue $39,600, Credit Deferred Revenue $39,600. Post as of 2026-03-31 close as a correcting entry. Then accept billing credit and reissue invoice for correct term.

alex_fin: I'll assemble the JE and memo for auditors. Action items: (1) Sam — attach signed amendment PDF in thread; (2) Alex — prepare JE + supporting schedule; (3) Jordan — review JE and post on 2026-03-31 close.
maria_revops: Please add note in the deferral schedule explaining reliance on signed amendment dated 2026-03-29. Also tag revenue impact on ARR forecast.
billing-bot: credit memo created CM-54321 for INV-98765; status: queued.

alex_fin: I've uploaded JE draft and schedule to /finance/monthend/working/AcmeCorp_INV-98765-issue.xlsx and will push to shared close folder by 11:00 PT. Reversal amount = $39,600.
jordan_accounting: I'll review and sign off once uploaded. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
alex_fin: Filing note: will include comment "post-close adjustment if anything else appears; contact revops immediately." Closing loop — will update thread when posted. :thumbsup:
